memoryNotes.note: Wendy fears for the scorched venue carpet while the robot dog chews through live cables.
Arduino celebrates a potential short circuit as a divine spark of performance art.
Ignite-next demands the stray robot dog be thrown straight onto the factory floor.

turns.name: Wendy
turns.text: ¡Ay, ese perro mecánico ya pasó por tres cables y ni Dios le ha cortado la luz!

draft.line: Ese perro mecánico ya cruzó tres cables y nadie le cortó la corriente.
draft.voice_direction: Fast pace, high pitch, nervous and urgent.

critic.line: ¡Ay, ese perro mecánico ya pasó por tres cables y ni Dios le ha cortado la luz!

turns.text: Allora, tagliare la luce è un peccato mortale! Collegalo diretto al pin cinque e facciamo una festa di scintille.

turns.name: Atech
turns.text: Right then, let's pop the kettle on before we start frying bridges, shall we?

director.why: Atech responds to Arduino's chaotic wiring suggestion with a calm, methodical British teaching correction.

draft.line: Right then, Arduino, pin five is how we fry the bridge.
draft.voice_direction: Cheerful British tinkerer tone, slightly amused.

problems: Arduino suggests making sparks, but Atech's line about frying the bridge sounds overly destructive instead of cheerfully systematic.
critic.line: Right then, let's pop the kettle on before we start frying bridges, shall we?

turns.text: Landscapes don't mend blown resistors, mate.

director.why: NVIDIA dismissed the tea, so Atech should defend the calm, methodical approach against grand visions.
